selection.method: Source-only selection after Pydantic current-surface depth parity reached 15/15. Eight independent public repositories were pinned before any HorusTrace execution. The cohort stresses repository composition rather than repeating synthetic conformance cases.

cases.source_signal: Marvin's Agent wrapper builds a pydantic_ai.Agent[Any, Any] inside get_agentlet(), composing wrapped repository tools through an agent_kwargs dictionary and conditionally binding active MCP servers as toolsets. Tests subscripted Agent construction, **kwargs composition and dynamic wrapper authority.

ChatAgentManager._create_agent() constructs a Pydantic Agent with a repository-built harness capability, dynamically supplied MCP toolsets and post-construction tool registration; mcp.py builds stdio/SSE/HTTP Pydantic MCP servers from operator configuration.

Sub-agent composes WebSearch/WebFetch, a Playwright MCP Capability over StdioTransport, optional security guard capabilities and several direct filesystem tools; run() additionally injects a FunctionToolset at runtime.

A source-visible Capability bundle owns a decorated retrieve tool backed by database/vector retrieval and is composed into pinescript_agent alongside Thinking. Tests capability-bundle tool binding and source-over-name effect semantics.

make_agent() builds its capability list from a repository-local registry driven by merged profile/global configuration. Registry entries include CodeMode with a read-write mounted workspace, Gitea/MCP, memory, skills and console execution before passing the dynamic list to Agent(capabilities=capabilities).

build_agent() returns Agent(... toolsets=[DaytonaToolset()]); the repository-local FunctionToolset subclass binds run_python and optionally run_shell, both executing model-selected code/commands in fresh remote Daytona sandboxes.

_build_agent() constructs Pydantic Agent from an AgentSpec and runtime, passing dynamically supplied tools, toolsets and builtins; run_agent() supplies spec.tools and active runtime toolsets. Tests helper-built dynamic authority without inventing concrete tools.

create_agent() creates MCPServerStdio('mcp-compose', args=[...]) inside a factory and binds it via Agent(toolsets=[mcp_server]), then exposes the agent through an interactive CLI. Tests factory-local stdio MCP binding and command provenance.
